Grade: Grade 7
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.5: Phonological Awareness

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Phonological Awareness, part of Listening and Speaking in Grade 7 MANDARIN.
